Реализационное следствие — это конкретный результат внедрения чего-либо, а абстракция — это обобщённое представление, не зависящее от деталей реализации.

memory_proposal.text: Implementation consequence refers to the concrete effects, behaviors, or outcomes that arise when a particular design, decision, or concept is realized in practice (i.e., when it is implemented in a specific context). Abstraction refers to the conceptual or theoretical layer that generalizes or omits details, focusing on essential features rather than specific implementations. The distinction is that abstraction operates at the level of general concepts or models, while implementation consequence concerns the specific, often unforeseen, results that manifest when an abstraction is instantiated or applied.
memory_proposal.grounds: This distinction clarifies that abstraction is about generalization and conceptualization, whereas implementation consequence is about what actually happens when those abstractions are made concrete. Recognizing this difference helps to anticipate and analyze the real-world effects that may not be apparent from the abstract model alone.
